messages.subject: Help with brms?
parts:
Hey D-RUGies,

Not 100% sure this is the best venue to ask for assistance, but it seemed more relevant than sending this out to EcoSocial:

I'm fairly new to modeling and Stan in general and would love some input on how to troubleshoot my models (they are running, but not converging + lots of divergent transitions) using the brms package. If you have experience with using this package (or with multivariate, multilevel, mixed models in general), please let me know if you'd be willing to chat with me for an hour or two. Happy to compensate in cash, beer, food, dog-training, etc. 

Ryane (you can respond to me directly - rlog...@ucdavis.edu)
